title: A persisted negative review-result recovery probe can hide a result durably appended later
outcome: A delegation review result that was durably appended to the mailbox is recovered at boot even when a recovery probe for the same attempt had earlier found no envelope and its negative result reached disk before the append's primary record did.
acceptance: A regression with the write-behind persistence worker connected (not the synchronous test fallback): a recovery probe records a miss for attempt N, the result for attempt N is then durably appended, and the host crashes before the primary record lands; after boot the result is recovered and the delegation is not left failed/unavailable.
Negative probes are invalidated at boot, or bound to a durable mailbox generation, so a cached miss never suppresses reading an envelope that exists.
